title: last30days Guide: Recent Research as an Agent Skill
summary: last30days packages recent social, developer, market, and web research into a reusable skill for AI agents.
author: OpenAgent.bot Editors
seoTitle: last30days Guide: Open-Source Recent Research Skill for AI Agents
seoDescription: A practical guide to last30days, an open-source AI agent skill for researching recent signals across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, GitHub, and the web.
body: [last30days](/skills/last30days-skill) is an agent skill for a problem that ordinary search often handles badly: what changed recently?
The project searches recent signals from sources such as Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, GitHub, and the web, then asks an agent to synthesize the useful signal into a brief.
## Why this is a skill, not just a prompt
A prompt can ask for recent research. A skill can encode the workflow: source selection, setup checks, optional credentials, scoring, synthesis, and citation behavior.
- A fast-moving AI tool or model release.
- A company before a sales call.
- A creator, founder, or open-source maintainer before a meeting.
- A product category where social complaints matter.
Recent social signal can be noisy. Check the strongest claims against source links, look for platform bias, and separate engagement from truth.
